papers.title: EgoCITE: Context-Augmented Indexing and Time-Aware Retrieval for Long-Horizon Egocentric Memory
papers.authors: Le Zhang, Ke Sun
papers.affiliations: University of Michigan, Ann Arbor
papers.intro: EgoCITE提出了一种面向长时程第一视角问答的智能体记忆框架，通过上下文增强的原子记忆索引（EgoScheme）和多视图时间感知检索（EgoIndex与EgoRetrv），显著优于现有智能体记忆基线，同时比长上下文LLM智能体降低36倍成本。

papers.title: XYZFlow:Scaling Multi dimensional Shortcut Flows for Efficient Generative Modeling
papers.authors: Jinxiu Liu, Xuanming Liu, Kangfu Mei, Yandong Wen, Weiyang Liu
papers.affiliations: CUHK, Westlake University, Johns Hopkins University
papers.intro: XYZFlow提出通过时间维度和空间维度的结构化多维条件化（特别是Next Shortcut Prediction）来缩放流匹配生成模型，使得概率路径更平直、更可学习，从而在极少的采样步数下达到接近教师模型的图像生成质量。

papers.title: Domain-Aware Lightweight Spectral-Grouped Convolutions for Hyperspectral Fish Freshness Classification
papers.authors: Kazi Nabiul Alam, Pooneh Bagheri Zadeh, Akbar Sheikh-Akbari
papers.affiliations: School of Built Environment, Engineering, and Computing, Leeds Beckett University, Leeds LS6 3QS, United Kingdom
papers.intro: 论文提出SGNet（Spectral-Grouped Network），一个通过分组卷积和深度可分离空间路径显式解耦光谱与空间特征提取、并融合轻量双注意力机制的轻量级高光谱鱼鲜度分类网络，在自建三文鱼数据集上以4.75M参数达到97.8%分类准确率和0.64天MAE。

papers.title: M-Net: Integrating Spectral Features and Physical Field Operators into Deep Learning for Medical Image Segmentation
papers.authors: Jing Zhu, Ye Wang, Fumin Wang
papers.affiliations: School of Physics, Xi'an Jiaotong University; University of Sydney
papers.intro: 本文提出M-Net（Math-Augmented Network），通过将矩阵条件数谱特征、向量微积分物理场算子（散度与类旋度边界不规则算子）以及数学注意力门（MAG）三类显式数学先验系统性集成进U-Net架构，在肝脏、肾脏和脑肿瘤分割基准上显著超越基线U-Net。

papers.title: Map-Det3D: Metric Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction Prior for Multi-view 3D Object Detection from Streaming Inputs
papers.authors: Yung-Hsu Yang, Luigi Piccinelli, Samuel Rota Bulò, Sunghwan Hong, Denis Rozumny, Johannes Schönberger, Zuria Bauer, Hermann Blum, Peter Kontschieder, Marc Pollefeys
papers.affiliations: ETH Zürich; Meta Reality Labs Zürich; University of Bonn
papers.intro: Map-Det3D提出将前馈度量3D重建模型（MapAnything）作为检测Transformer的几何编码器，直接在重建出的3D空间中预测度量3D边界框，避免传统的2D-to-3D lifting路径，从而在流式单目视频输入下实现稳健的在线多视图3D检测。

papers.title: HandEdit: A Unified Benchmark for Egocentric Human-to-Robot Dexterous Hand Image Editing
papers.authors: Zhenjie Yang, Xingyu Jiao, Guopeng Zhong, Shuzhe Yang, Shi Che, Chao Wu, Chenyu Jiang, Dongjie Zhang, Yideng Zhang, Zheng Zhang, Muyun Jiang, Haisheng Su, Shuang Jin, Donghang Zhang, Chao Yang, Li Chen, Hongyang Li, Zuxuan Wu, Yu-Gang Jiang, Xiaosong Jia, Junchi Yan
papers.affiliations: Fudan University; Inspire Robots; Shanghai Jiao Tong University; The University of Hong Kong; Nanyang Technological University; Shanghai AI Laboratory
papers.intro: HandEdit 是一个大规模具身感知图像编辑数据集与基准，专门用于将自我中心视角的人类手/手臂图像转换为多种URDF定义的机器人灵巧手/手-臂形态，并提供了统一的评估协议和多维度指标。

papers.title: RA-ClipScore: Making Generative Model Evaluation More Interpretable
papers.authors: Yifan Lu, Taras Kucherenko, Hedvig Kjellström, Judith Bütepage
papers.affiliations: KTH Royal Institute of Technology, National Library of Sweden, SEED, Electronic Arts (EA)
papers.intro: 本文提出RA-CLIPScore——一种基于CLIP的区域与属性感知生成模型评估指标，通过双提示（dual prompts）解耦属性竞争，并利用局部patch token实现细粒度区域级语义评估，首次将CLIP-based评估扩展到空间分布对齐分析，提供更稳健、可解释且无需训练的高效度量。

papers.title: Predicting Functions, Not Features: KANs with Function-Space Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning for Medical Image Segmentation
papers.authors: Yungeng Liu, Xuanzi Fang, Yuge Zhang, Shuqi Ren, Haijin Zeng, Yongyong Chen
papers.affiliations: Harbin Institute of Technology, Shenzhen；The University of Hong Kong
papers.intro: 本文提出FS-JEPA框架，在KAN分割网络中把联合嵌入预测学习扩展到边聚合前的函数空间，通过从掩码在线分支预测全上下文EMA目标分支生成的多半径边函数签名，显式学习KAN边函数的局部结构，从而提升医学图像分割性能。

papers.title: Seed2GS: Camera-Free, Training-Free Object Extraction from 3D Gaussian Scenes via a Single Reference-View Grounding
papers.authors: Zongjian Ding, Yudong Gao, Jiale Liu, Xinglin Yu, Junxing Ren, Dong Wei, Yajing Chen, Shan Huang, Mingjun Cheng, Min Li
papers.affiliations: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences; Institute of Information Engineering, Chinese Academy of Sciences; Zhejiang University; The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology; Beijing Institute of Technology
papers.intro: Seed2GS 提出一种"一次接地、跟踪传播、临时拟合"的3DGS目标提取方法，仅需一个参考视图和文本提示，即可在无原始重建相机、无场景特定训练的条件下达到当前最高的LERF-MASK分割精度。

papers.title: CoQui: A Coordinate-Conditioned Quantum Implicit Generative Adversarial Network for End-to-End Image Generation
papers.authors: Xue Yang, Rigui Zhou, ShiZheng Jia, Dax Enshan Koh, Siong Thye Goh, Young-Wook Cho, YaoChong Li, Xuezhi Ma, Hongyu Chen, Xin Wang
papers.affiliations: 多个机构，详见“作者机构”部分
papers.intro: CoQui将量子图像生成重新表述为坐标条件的隐式函数学习，通过经典嵌入网络生成量子电路参数，在每个空间坐标上查询一个变分量子电路，直接从颜色量子比特的期望值读出像素强度，从而将量子比特数从图像分辨率中解耦并避免像素间的概率竞争。

papers.title: BoltNet: An Ultra-Lightweight Convolutional Network for On-Device Plant Species Identification
papers.authors: Daniel Rossi, Guido Borghi, Roberto Vezzani
papers.affiliations: University of Modena and Reggio Emilia, Modena, Italy
papers.intro: BoltNet是一种超轻量全卷积网络，通过空间重分配瓶颈（Spatial Redistribution Bottleneck）和Logit预采样（Logit Pre-Sampling）两个无参数重排操作，在仅341K参数（1.37 MB）下于Pl@ntNet-300K达到0.682 F1-score…

papers.title: Capturing Uncertainty in Human Motion for Representation Learning in Soccer
papers.authors: Yizhou Xu, Lars Bretzner, Tiesheng Wang, Atsuto Maki
papers.affiliations: KTH Royal Institute of Technology（KTH皇家理工学院）、EA Sports TRACAB
papers.intro: 论文提出一种以未来运动预测为自监督目标的表征学习框架，通过学习3D关节运动空间中的离散未来分布来显式建模运动不确定性，在足球场景中显著提升运动预测精度，并有效迁移至动作识别与事件检测等下游任务。

papers.title: VidForensics-M1: Meta-Detection Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Temporal Grounding for AI-Generated Video Forensics
papers.authors: Bowei Liu, Zheng Lu, Yuhan Bian, Xinchen Zhang, Xingming Shui, Yuesheng Huang, Xuhuan Li, Zihao Liu, Yifan Yang, Jun Zhou, Xiu Li
papers.affiliations: Tsinghua University; Peking University; Renmin University of China; Microsoft
papers.intro: VidForensics-M1 首次将“元检测”（meta-detection）概念引入AI生成视频检测，通过基于规则的时间定位作为可验证证据，结合证据引导的奖励重分配（EGRR）与强化学习，联合优化标签正确性和证据可靠性，从而提升检测的鲁棒性与泛化能力。

papers.title: Test-Time Self-Evolving GUI Visual Grounding via Reflection-Guided On-Policy Self-Distillation
papers.authors: Shiyu Xuan, Zechao Li
papers.tags: visual grounding, multimodal learning, scene understanding
papers.affiliations: School of Computer Science and Engineering, Nanjing University of Science and Technology, Nanjing, China, 210094
papers.intro: 本文提出一种测试时自进化框架，通过多模态大模型反思器生成评估与文本反思，并利用反思引导的在线策略自蒸馏和对比校准方法，使GUI视觉定位模型在无真实标注的情况下从自身成功和失败的探索中持续学习改进。

papers.title: MultiModal Code-Switching: Interleaving Visual Objects into Language for Explicit Object-Level Alignment
papers.authors: Changhao Xiang, Shangyu Xing, Zhen Wu, Jianbing Zhang, Xinyu Dai
papers.affiliations: National Key Laboratory for Novel Software Technology, Nanjing University, China
papers.intro: 本文提出一种名为MultiModal Code-Switching (MMCS)的新型预训练范式，通过将文本实体替换为对应的视觉对象，构造交错的多模态序列，从而提供显式的对象级对齐监督，显著提升数据效率和视觉接地能力。

papers.title: CausalSplat: Towards Comprehensive Hierarchical Reasoning in 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.authors: Jiayu Ding, Meilu Song, Yun Chen, Wei Gao, Ge Li
papers.affiliations: Peking University Shenzhen Graduate School; North China Electric Power University; Hunan University; Peking University Shenzhen Graduate School（注：第一作者、第四、第五作者同属北京大学深圳研究生院，第二作者属华北电力大学，第三作者属湖南大学）
papers.intro: 论文提出CausalSplat框架，通过将2D分割掩码提升为3D语义场、构建多模态语义场景图、并利用大语言模型进行分层推理，首次系统性地解决了3D高斯场景中涵盖常识、空间、可供性和反事实推理的分割任务，同时构建了Causal-LERF和Causal-ScanNet两个推理基准。

papers.title: SAR2Agri: Learning SAR Intensity Representations for Agricultural Monitoring
papers.authors: Moti Rattan Gupta, Anupam Sobti
papers.affiliations: Plaksha University, Mohali, Punjab, India
papers.intro: 本文提出首个仅使用SAR强度影像的农业监测自监督预训练流程，通过将物候感知时间预文本任务与掩膜、课程学习相结合，在SICKLE基准上的作物类型制图任务达到84.9% IoU，显著超过光学和现有SAR基线。

papers.title: Is There Really a Camouflaged Object? Towards Realistic Camouflaged Object Detection
papers.authors: Huafeng Chen, Yueming Lyu, Chenyang Si, Wende Tan, Liucheng Guo, Caifeng Shan
papers.affiliations: School of Intelligence Science and Technology, Nanjing University; Department of Computing, Imperial College London
papers.intro: 该论文提出大规模真实COD基准OPC16K和存在感知网络OPCNet，通过层次化存在推理、相似度感知伪装关系建模和存在感知特征细化，将COD从纯分割任务重构为目标定位与伪装存在性推理的联合问题，在显著降低负样本假阳性率的同时保持精确的伪装目标分割性能。

papers.title: Learning Gaussian Structure: Intervention-Guided Density Control for Feed-Forward Driving Reconstruction
papers.authors: Hang Li, Jiahe Li, Meiying Gu, Jin Zheng, Lina Yu, Xiao Bai
papers.affiliations: Beihang University; Institute of Semiconductors, Chinese Academy of Sciences
papers.intro: 论文提出LGS框架，通过干预引导的密度控制策略动态调整高斯原语的增删结构，并利用跨时间点查询显式聚合其他时间戳的特征，从而在无需逐场景优化的情况下提升驾驶场景的feed-forward重建质量。

papers.title: CapProbe: Evaluating Detailed Image Captions via Full-Scene Dense Question Answering
papers.authors: Mouxiao Huang, Qiangyu Yan, Borui Jiang, Han Shu
papers.tags: semantic segmentation, instance segmentation, Segment Anything, image captioning
papers.affiliations: Huawei Technologies
papers.intro: CapProbe通过将每张图像分解为语义区域并为每个区域生成密集多选题，构建了一个全场景密集QA基准，从而把详细图像描述评估转化为区域对齐的事实核查，解决了传统和LLM打分方法难以验证细粒度事实的问题。
